notes:
Included Services:

1. Weatherization: Seal 4 A/C units with foam; seal basement side door with foam. Seal any doors needed.
2. Caulking: Precision application around one window and baseboard sides.
3. Screen: Build and install one custom screen (approx. 24" x 20").
4. Door Maintenance: Adjust latches on front and back doors for proper flush closure. Hinge tune-up. 
5. Carpentry: Install plywood/MDF risers on 6 basement stairs.
6. Prevention: Bug Treatment around perimeter and problem areas.

Timing:
Work will be completed in one (1) full day. I will arrive at 8am and plan to wrap up by 5-7pm.

Payment Terms:
- Total Project Cost: $520 (Includes 20% off Labor)
- Material Deposit: $120 (Due upon agreement to schedule the work).
- Balance: $400 (Due immediately upon completion of services).

I am requesting the material cost upfront so I can purchase the supplies and ensure everything is ready to go for our scheduled day.

Warranty:
I stand by my craftsmanship. If any of the work performed (specifically door latch adjustments or riser installation) fails due to installation error within 30 days, I will return to rectify it at no additional labor cost. This does not cover material failure or new damage.
